cases.canonicalJourney: CustomerOrg-X invited -> RFQ -> provider inbox -> quote approved -> customer acceptance
cases.canonicalThen: Customer sees own business objects; provider sees only allowed queue; no Booked until capacity

given: Provider Tenant-A has a verified CustomerAccount-X relationship; CustomerAccount-Y is a separate restricted customer
Invitation and resource grants are valid and individually scoped; Quote signing rules remain gated by BR-01/02 and EDS approvals
There is no committed CapacityReservation at journey start
whenSteps: CustomerOrg-X accepts its own invitation and creates RFQ DRAFT
Authorized Customer-X actor submits only after PR-05 permission is approved; otherwise assert DENY
Provider operator receives only the authorized Inbox entry and creates immutable QuoteVersion
Authorized signatory proves acceptance on the exact quote hash under approved BR/EDS contract
Customer checks own RFQ/Quote projection, then attempts Booking without capacity

expected.http: Customer-X sees only own RFQ/Quote; Customer-Y count/detail/export excludes X; unauthorized submit/accept DENY
expected.db: QuoteVersion immutable and no BOOKING.CONFIRMED without valid exclusive capacity and carrier requirement
expected.events: No false QuoteAccepted or BookingConfirmed before necessary signed/capacity evidence
expected.ui: Separate DRAFT, ISSUED, ACCEPTED (only when approved), NO CAPACITY states
expected.canonicalThen: Customer sees own business objects; provider sees only allowed queue; no Booked until capacity

negativeVariants: Same idempotencyKey different cargo payload CONFLICT
Cross-customer pagination/count must not leak resource existence

cases.canonicalJourney: Forwarder + external carrier -> offer -> capacity hold -> confirmed booking
cases.canonicalThen: Customer can see Booking confirmed only after authoritative Fleet and compliance verification

given: Immutable accepted QuoteVersion and verified CarrierOffer are available only under approved legal profile
Two overlapping capacity consumers share one vehicle combination
Compliance rule source is verified, route assessed and not UNKNOWN
whenSteps: Provider selects an authorized CarrierOffer, separately from confirmation of carrier commitment
Fleet executes exclusive capacity hold with expectedVersion and TTL
External carrier confirms commitment under valid authority
Booking process tests confirmation with and without independently valid CapacityReservation
Repeat and race a competing hold while comparing customer Booking projection

expected.http: Only valid authorized provider/customer queries expose resulting Booking state
expected.db: Only one exclusive reservation; Booking.CONFIRMED iff contractual/compliance/capacity predicates hold
expected.events: No duplicate BookingConfirmed or phantom CapacityReserved under race/replay
expected.ui: OfferSelected, CapacityHeld, CarrierCommitted and BookingConfirmed shown as different facts
expected.canonicalThen: Customer can see Booking confirmed only after authoritative Fleet and compliance verification

negativeVariants: Concurrent overlapping branch hold must not succeed twice

cases.canonicalThen: No fake CarrierOffer required, same exclusive reservation invariants

Create and confirm one exclusive CapacityReservation under authorized own-fleet actor

expected.http: Own-fleet fulfillment can be queried without a fake external carrier offer
expected.db: Vehicle resource exclusivity preserved and no synthetic CarrierOffer persisted
expected.events: Only authoritative capacity and booking facts emitted; duplicate hold rejected
expected.ui: Own-fleet path shown distinctly from external carrier procurement
expected.canonicalThen: No fake CarrierOffer required, same exclusive reservation invariants

cases.canonicalJourney: Driver online/offline pickup -> partial POD 8/10 -> remaining returned
cases.canonicalThen: Cargo conservation and original proof immutable; track customer-safe statuses

given: Trip and driver assignment are verified and not revoked
Exactly 10 immutable HandlingUnit IDs exist; no previous custody receipt
Receiver has narrow delivery-attempt scope; offline event IDs are globally unique within correct tenant
whenSteps: Driver scans 10 units and commits online custody pickup with original evidence
Driver goes offline; stores signed-scoped movement event and reopens local pending queue
Receiver accepts exactly 8 units; marks remaining 2 refused/return-pending with named custodian
Replay same and changed-digest offline eventIds while network recovers
Record return/disposition of 2 units under authorized custody transition, never overwrite original POD

expected.http: Shipment shows PARTIAL_DELIVERY while 8/10; no customer-facing full-delivery claim
expected.db: 8 accepted + 2 retained = 10; 2 named custodian/disposition; no duplicate unit handover; immutable evidence hash
expected.events: Inbox dedup, changed digest conflict/quarantine; no ShipmentDelivered until full verified final disposition
expected.ui: Partial delivery, damaged/refused count and named remaining custody visible; review disabled for partial
expected.canonicalThen: Cargo conservation and original proof immutable; track customer-safe statuses

negativeVariants: Revoked driver assignment with forged observedAt DENY
Duplicate offline event with different payload hash quarantined

Two separate variants: Trip has NOT STARTED, and Trip already STARTED with active custody
Cancellation authority/rules BR-11 and DEC-R0-04 remain pending and must fail closed
whenSteps: Customer submits CancelRequest; do not mutate Booking immediately
Authorized approver tries cancellation before Trip.STARTED and records decision or DENY if policy pending

Attempt cancellation after active custody and inspect protected resource transitions

expected.http: CancelRequest response never claims Booking CANCELLED until independent authorization succeeds
expected.db: Trip.STARTED prevents unsafe resource release; cargo custody never orphaned
expected.events: At most one authorized cancellation/compensation, no duplicate release on replay
expected.ui: Separate requested, denied/pending, approved and recovery states
expected.canonicalThen: Request-only separation and correct compensation/custody branch

cases.canonicalJourney: Revoke CustomerAccount grant while read cache and signed link active
cases.canonicalThen: Future protected API denies; signed URL TTL semantics explicit

given: Tenant-A has two separately scoped CustomerAccounts X/Y
Customer-X has cached list/detail and a signed document link with explicit original TTL
The authoritative grant can be revoked while JWT remains signed and unexpired
whenSteps: Customer-X reads authorized resources and obtains a bounded signed URL
Provider revokes only Customer-X grant
Customer-X reuses same JWT against list/count/detail/export
Customer-X tries new signed link and old link before/after documented TTL
Customer-Y independently repeats its allowed read

expected.http: All new protected calls immediately DENY, including list counts and new link issuance
expected.db: No foreign reads or disclosure; audit records denied attempt where specified without revealing resource
expected.events: Revocation propagates to read cache/subscription; no new data export
expected.ui: Cached protected content invalidated; old signed link limitation disclosed; no false instantaneous revoke claim
expected.canonicalThen: Future protected API denies; signed URL TTL semantics explicit

negativeVariants: Warm cache served after grant revoke
Signed URL remaining TTL cannot exceed reviewed policy

cases.canonicalJourney: Carrier withdraws after customer accepted quote before/after hold
cases.canonicalThen: Booking never falsely confirmed; exception and replacement sourced safely

given: Customer approved exact QuoteVersion under applicable BR/EDS approval
CarrierOffer is selected but carrier might withdraw before or after resource hold
whenSteps: Carrier submits withdrawal before CapacityReservation and provider tries Booking
Provider requests alternative authorized CarrierOffer; stale offer confirmation rejected
Repeat with capacity hold already active when carrier withdraws
Process manager compensates/reconciles hold and booking state under authorized rule

expected.http: Customer never sees Booking.CONFIRMED without all authoritative predicates
expected.db: Stale/withdrawn offer not usable; capacity hold and booking reconcile to one coherent state
expected.events: No phantom booking or duplicate reservation on replay; exception/replacement is durable
expected.ui: Carrier withdrawn and reallocation/recovery shown, not a fake confirmation
expected.canonicalThen: Booking never falsely confirmed; exception and replacement sourced safely

negativeVariants: Replayed carrier withdrawal after new offer selection
